description: This file defines a PHP class 'License' within the 'OrangeHRM' HR management system. The class extends 'ListableDisplayField' and specifies methods for returning DTO class information, entity aliases, and report fields related to licenses. It appears to be part of a reporting module, specifically customizing display fields for license information.

classes.name: License
classes.description: Represents a display field configuration for licenses in HRM reports, providing methods to specify DTO class, entity aliases, and report fields.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the Data Transfer Object (DTO) associated with this display field.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns an array of entity alias names used in reporting queries.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns an array of database fields or report fields associated with this display field.
